videos.title: The Security Camera Showed Someone Behind Him
videos.topic: A night-shift security guard keeps seeing a figure on the lobby camera standing behind him, until he learns the camera feed is a live view of the building's empty twin across the street, and the figure is watching him through the real window.
videos.genre: creepy short fiction with a twist ending (clearly fiction)

videos.title: The Ship Found Sailing With Nobody Aboard
videos.topic: The 1872 discovery of the Mary Celeste, a ship found drifting in the Atlantic with no one on board, and the unsolved question of why everyone left.
